title: Thai Veggie Patties with Minty Pineapple-Cucumber Salad & Peanuts

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Divide between two medium bowls, then set one bowl aside for the salad.

Peel and mince garlic. Add to the remaining bowl with the green onions along with veggie ground, bread crumbs, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and spices. Use your hands to combine the veggie ground mixture. Using a scant ¼-cup measure, form the mixture into ½-inch thick patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add patties and cook, flipping once, until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, add soy sauce, vinegar, salt, and pepper to the remaining bowl with the green onions. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and cut the flesh into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide patties and salad between plates or bowls. Top salad with peanuts and enjoy!
